programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E1
programme.desc: Cameo Project, Bayu Skak, dan SkinnyIndonesian24—tiga nama besar yang menjadi pelopor YouTube Indonesia dengan kanal yang sangat berpengaruh dan berdampak besar. Saat ini, banyak orang dapat dengan mudah meraih popularitas dalam waktu singkat. Hal tersebut tidaklah salah, namun menjadi dipertanyakan ketika popularitas, kekuatan, dan pengaruh tersebut tidak dimanfaatkan secara bijak.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E2
programme.desc: Tim2one yang dikenal secara regional—atau Chandra Liow—memulai kanalnya dari video tutorial After Effects saat ia masih duduk di bangku SMP. Harbatah, yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Duo Harbatah, kini menjadi kanal yang dikenal luas dan pada awalnya memparodikan budaya Arab.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E3
programme.desc: Kenalkan Rivaldo Santosa, sosok di balik kanal YouTube Detective Aldo yang dikenal luas karena membahas secara mendalam topik okultisme, kriminalitas, serta berbagai aspek sejarah Indonesia. Lalu ada Nessie Judge yang terkenal, seorang perempuan muda yang gemar membagikan fakta, cerita, dan informasi menarik kepada Nerrorists—sebutan khas untuk para pengikutnya.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E4
programme.desc: Menampilkan grup musik Eclat Story (Yosua Gunawan, Yeshua Abraham, dan Louis Xander Liang), Rani Ramadhany, serta Eka Gustiwana—bagi mereka, musik adalah inti dari semangat dalam berkarya. Kecintaan mereka yang begitu besar terhadap musik dan bunyi tidak hanya memengaruhi cara mereka mengambil keputusan penting dalam hidup, tetapi juga menjadi faktor penentu dalam perjalanan hidup mereka.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E5
programme.desc: Marlo Ernesto, Cania Citta Irlaine, dan Gritte Agatha menggunakan suara mereka sebagai alat yang kuat untuk menyampaikan pesan. More Than Words membuka ruang percakapan, memicu perdebatan sosial, menghibur penonton, dan masih banyak lagi.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E6
programme.desc: Jovi Adhiguna Hunter adalah seorang pengusaha sekaligus content creator yang kerap membuat konten seputar fashion, kecantikan, gaya hidup, dan F&B. Lifni Sanders, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Livjunkie, adalah seorang perempuan berdarah Papua dan Tionghoa yang berprofesi sebagai content creator dengan menjadikan makeup dan skincare sebagai kontennya.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E7
programme.desc: JWestBros dibentuk oleh dua pemuda, Andy Garcia dan Victor Samuel. Mereka aktif membuat konten ulasan kuliner dan perjalanan yang dikemas dengan visual sinematik yang indah. Selain itu, ada Sutiknyo yang juga dikenal dengan nama Tekno Bolang.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E8
programme.desc: Episode ini menampilkan 3 YouTuber horor di Indonesia, yaitu Kisah Tanah Jawa yang selalu membahas mitos dan sejarah di Pulau Jawa; kemudian Filo Sebastian, seorang pria berkacamata yang memiliki kemampuan indigo; serta HAGZ dengan nama asli Alvin Vajhrin, yang di kanalnya membahas berbagai misteri atau mitos yang terjadi di masyarakat.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E9
programme.desc: Memiliki hobi yang bisa menghasilkan adalah impian banyak orang. Termasuk hobi bermain gim yang dilakukan oleh tiga YouTuber ini, yaitu Tara Arts, Frost Diamond, dan Ani Nurhayani. Tara Arts, yang digawangi oleh Tara dan Gema, merupakan YouTuber gim yang bisa dibilang senior karena sudah mulai membuat konten YouTube sejak tahun 2009.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E10
programme.desc: Sacha Stevenson secara unik memerankan berbagai karakter dalam karya-karyanya dan tidak lupa membahas banyak hal tentang kisah pribadinya sebagai seorang Kaukasia yang tinggal di Indonesia. Aulion, dengan karya stop motion serta warna-warna cerah yang menjadi ciri khasnya, mampu menarik perhatian dan senyum penonton karena beragam ide kreatif yang lahir dari pikirannya.

Mereka harus menyelesaikan masalah tersebut dengan memainkan tiga permainan di sebuah gedung terbengkalai yang dikabarkan berhantu. Misteri itu akhirnya terungkap — Hantu Buntung ternyata hanyalah seorang siswa yang mengenakan kostum hantu untuk menghindari perundungan dan agar tetap aman dari para pengganggu di sekolah.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 10
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.title: Black Clover S1, Ep 30
programme.desc: Asta dan Yuno ditinggalkan bersama di gereja yang sama dan sejak saat itu tak terpisahkan. Saat masih kecil, mereka berjanji akan saling bersaing untuk menentukan siapa yang akan menjadi Kaisar Penyihir berikutnya.

programme.title: Tsukimichi S2, Ep 5
programme.desc: Misumi Makoto, seorang siswa SMA yang hidupnya biasa saja tiba-tiba terpanggil untuk menjadi seorang "Pahlawan" di dunia yang memanggilnya.Nahasnya, Sang Dewi dari dunia ini mengatakan dia terlalu buruk rupa dan mengasingkannya di tempat terpencil dimana banyak spesies mengerikan hidup. Naga, laba-laba, orc, kurcaci, dan spesies mengerikan lainnya selalu dihadapinya saat menjelajahi hutan belantara

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Raja Kera bereinkarnasi dalam wujud bukan manusia sebagai Joker, seorang perampok jalanan yang tidak menyadari identitas aslinya dan fakta bahwa 500 tahun sebelumnya, dia dan tuannya, Biksu Panjang Umur, dihukum dan dipaksa untuk tetap menjadi manusia.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Seorang playboy kaya tewas akibat diledakkan oleh seorang gangster ketika ia menggoda istri gangster tersebut. Melalui serangkaian kejadian, profesornya membuatkan tubuh sintetis yang memungkinkannya untuk berubah menjadi apa pun yang diinginkannya.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Seluruh sekolah disandera saat kompetisi pidato bahasa Inggris berlangsung. Ip Man pun memutuskan untuk bangkit dan menghadapi krisis, serta menemukan bahwa dalangnya adalah sang guru dan teman masa kecilnya.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: Drunken Master

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi dan PI Lam mencuri dua plat USD100 yang dicuri di Hong Kong. Lam kehilangan mereka - tidak ada hadiah dari AS. Lam dan ketiga malaikat kecilnya mencoba mendapatkannya kembali di Seoul, begitu pula JJ. Banyak pertarungan.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley diberi kemampuan untuk menahan godaan dari lawan jenis namun hal itu menjadi beban ketika ia hendak menikahi kekasihnya.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant

programme.title: Face To Face

programme.title: Brandon Thomas-Asante : The Big Interview
programme.desc: While Coventry City have waited 25 years for their return to the top-flight, it's been a lifetime's work for Sky Blues striker Brandon Thomas-Asante. Having toiled hard in the lower leagues for a number of years, the Ghana international made his World Cup debut this summer and can now look forward to a first Premier League appearance at the home of the champions, for the opening match of the 2026/27 season.

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: Pak Guru Huruf G Nya Pasti Dari Galak
programme.desc: Bagus adalah seorang guru yang sudah lama ditinggal meninggal oleh istrinya. Bagus hidup bersama anaknya yang cantik, Siska. Tanpa Bagus ketahui, diam-diam Siska disukai oleh Gerry. Siska pun menyukai Gerry hingga mereka memutuskan untuk pacaran.Namun, Bagus yang merupakan guru di sekolah Siska, tidak suka dengan kedekatan Siska dan Gerry karena menurutnya anaknya masih kecil. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja motor Bagus dan Gerry tabrakan. Bagus kaget saat mengetahui bahwa Gerry dan Siska dekat. Di sisi lain Bagus yang sudah duda coba buat mendekati Indri, guru cantik di sekolah Siska. Namun, Siska kesal karena Bagus menyetujui hubungannya dengan diri, tapi malah mendekati Indri.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Ditiup Kamu Bikin Cenat-Cenut
programme.desc: Bastian adalah seorang cowok manja yang baru jatuh miskin karena perusahaan keluarganya bangkrut. Ia pun sedang mencari pekerjaan. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja Bastian menabrak Maesaroh yang sedang berjalan dan membawa wadah makanan. Bastian dengan sigap membantu Maesaroh hingga wadah makanannya tidak berantakan. Tanpa sengaja, Bastian dan Maesaroh berpelukan. Maesaroh yang merupakan gadis asli Betawi dan menyukai tanjidor karena itu adalah warisan babehnya, mengajak Bastian bergabung di grup tanjidor miliknya. Bastian pun setuju dan mau bekerja di tempat Maesaroh. Sejak saat itu, Bastian dan Maesaroh pun menjadi dekat dan lengket. Padahal, Bastian dan Maesaroh sudah dijodohkan oleh ibu mereka masing-masing dengan anak orang kaya, tapi keduanya menolak.

programme.desc: Dua puluh laga dalam karier profesionalnya, peraih medali emas Olimpiade Lennox Lewis mengambil langkah untuk merebut gelar Kejuaraan Dunia pertamanya. programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah Canelo Alvarez melawan Kermit Cintron dalam pertarungan yang telah membantu mengangkat Alvarez ke dalam perebutan gelar juara kelas menengah ringan dan mengambil satu langkah lagi untuk menjadi salah satu nama terbesar dalam dunia tinju. Juga ada dalam kartu pertandingan, aksi dari pertarungan klasik antara Joel Casamayor dan Michael Katsidis untuk memperebutkan gelar WBO Lightweight.

programme.title: World's Bargain Dream Homes (S1)
programme.desc: A Seattle couple's ready to start a family in Spain, and with a local property expert, they tour breathtaking bargain homes near Granada.

programme.title: Rock The Block (S7)
programme.desc: Teams create one-of-a-kind spaces in their multi-generation suites adding something old, new, borrowed or blue before they judge each other.

programme.title: Homes Gone Wild (S2)
programme.desc: Jack visits a treetop oasis made from salvaged materials, a home made from bottles, and a 19th-century house made from three merged structures.

programme.title: House Hunters (S1)
programme.desc: A New Jersey couple is ready to move to Florida. With their second baby on the way, this couple is on a tight deadline to find their dream home.

programme.title: The Food That Built Asia, Ep 3
programme.desc: The Food That Built Asia merupakan sebuah program TV nan menghibur dan informatif yang mengeksplorasi beberapa hidangan paling ikonik di Asia beserta perjalanannya menuju ketenaran di dunia domestik dan internasional.

programme.title: The Food That Built Asia, Ep 4
programme.desc: The Food That Built Asia merupakan sebuah program TV nan menghibur dan informatif yang mengeksplorasi beberapa hidangan paling ikonik di Asia beserta perjalanannya menuju ketenaran di dunia domestik dan internasional.

programme.title: Food That Built World S5, Ep 11
programme.desc: Cerita tentang keluarga-keluarga di balik makanan yang membangun Amerika, mereka yang menggunakan kecerdasan, tenaga, darah, keringat, dan air mata untuk menembus hati Amerika melalui perutnya, mereka yang menciptakan teknologi baru dan membantu memenangkan perang.

programme.title: Hidden Cities Extreme S2, Ep 3
programme.desc: Musim kedua Hidden Cities Extreme menghadirkan petualangan yang lebih berani saat Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk merasakan langsung tradisi dan kebiasaan yang tidak biasa. Mulai dari berburu tikus di Filipina, menyelam bebas di Indonesia, meminum urine sapi di India, mengikuti balap unta di Mongolia Dalam, hingga berlatih menjadi ninja di Jepang, setiap perjalanan memperlihatkan sisi budaya yang jarang diketahui wisatawan. Dengan berinteraksi langsung bersama masyarakat setempat, serial ini mengungkap kisah-kisah unik dan pengalaman ekstrem yang memperlihatkan keberagaman budaya Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

Mulai dari berburu tikus di Filipina, menyelam bebas di Indonesia, meminum urine sapi di India, mengikuti balap unta di Mongolia Dalam, hingga berlatih menjadi ninja di Jepang, setiap perjalanan memperlihatkan sisi budaya yang jarang diketahui wisatawan. Dengan berinteraksi langsung bersama masyarakat setempat, serial ini mengungkap kisah-kisah unik dan pengalaman ekstrem yang memperlihatkan keberagaman budaya Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

programme.title: Food That Built World S5, Ep 11
programme.desc: Cerita tentang keluarga-keluarga di balik makanan yang membangun Amerika, mereka yang menggunakan kecerdasan, tenaga, darah, keringat, dan air mata untuk menembus hati Amerika melalui perutnya, mereka yang menciptakan teknologi baru dan membantu memenangkan perang.

programme.title: Greatest Warriors, Ep 1
programme.desc: History's Greatest Warriors mengulas proses pembentukan berbagai pasukan tempur paling disegani sepanjang sejarah, mulai dari Viking, Samurai, Spartan, Knights Templar, Mongol, Navy SEAL, Delta Force, hingga prajurit Aztec. Setiap episode menelusuri perjalanan seorang prajurit sejak proses seleksi, latihan yang sangat berat, penguasaan senjata, strategi bertempur, hingga nilai-nilai yang membentuk mereka menjadi petarung elite. Dipadukan dengan analisis sejarah, rekonstruksi pertempuran, dan penjelasan dari para ahli, serial ini memberikan gambaran mendalam tentang rahasia di balik lahirnya para pejuang paling tangguh di dunia.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Wheel Of Fusion
programme.desc: Persaingan semakin menantang ketika para peserta harus menciptakan hidangan fusion berdasarkan kombinasi kuliner dari berbagai negara yang ditentukan secara acak melalui roda tantangan. Mereka dituntut memadukan cita rasa, teknik memasak, dan karakter khas dari dua budaya kuliner menjadi satu sajian yang inovatif dan seimbang. Di bawah penilaian Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich, dan Tiffany Derry, kreativitas, ketepatan teknik, serta keharmonisan rasa menjadi faktor utama untuk bertahan dan melaju ke babak berikutnya.

programme.title: Sheriff Country S1: Plus One
programme.desc: Sheriff Mickey Fox kembali dihadapkan pada penyelidikan yang penuh tantangan ketika bukti-bukti baru mengarah pada hubungan tersembunyi dan pihak-pihak yang tidak pernah diduga sebelumnya. Di tengah upayanya menjaga keamanan kota, ia harus menghadapi dinamika hubungan pribadi dan konflik yang berpotensi mengganggu proses penegakan hukum. Dengan tekanan yang terus meningkat, Mickey mengandalkan ketajaman insting dan keteguhannya untuk mengungkap fakta sebelum keadaan menjadi semakin berbahaya. Episode "Plus One" memadukan misteri, drama emosional, dan ketegangan dalam sebuah investigasi yang semakin kompleks.

programme.title: Fire Country S4: Firefighter (Hits Now)
programme.desc: Saat Stasiun 42 berjuang melewati shift yang tanpa henti, kembalinya Kepala Batalyon Brett Richards yang tak terduga membuat kru kehilangan keseimbangan dan memaksa Manny untuk menghadapi keraguan diri yang semakin tumbuh dalam dirinya.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Sunny Girl
programme.desc: Sunny Girl

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Kompilasi perjalanan cinta Aldebaran dan Andin yang penuh lika-liku, mulai dari kesalahpahaman, pengorbanan, hingga perjuangan mempertahankan keluarga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)
programme.desc: Usai kecelakaan yang merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap jalanan. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi cinta, hingga rahasia adopsi dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terlanjur Mencintaimu
programme.desc: Arumi, seorang barista keliling pekerja keras, menikah dengan Rendi, namun kemudian mengetahui bahwa pria itu sudah beristri dan hanya memanfaatkannya demi mendapatkan pewaris. Sempat mengira bayinya telah meninggal, ia akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran dan menemukan harapan baru bersama Elio.

programme.title: Terlanjur Mencintaimu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Arumi, barista keliling, menikahi Rendi yang ternyata telah beristri dan memanfaatkannya demi keturunan. Setelah bayinya dikira meninggal, Arumi mengungkap fakta mengejutkan. Di tengah luka, ia menemukan harapan bersama Elio.

programme.title: Microdrama + : Ceo Bucin
programme.desc: Dinda, office girl sederhana yang hidupnya penuh tekanan, tak pernah menyangka nasibnya berubah setelah bertemu Raga, CEO muda dingin yang diam-diam jatuh hati padanya. Di tengah fitnah kantor, perbedaan status, dan penolakan keluarga, cinta mereka diuji habis-habisan. Saat Dinda memilih pergi demi harga diri, Raga harus membuktikan satu hal: seberapa jauh ia berani melawan dunia demi cinta sejatinya.

programme.title: CEO Bucin
programme.desc: Dinda, karyawan sederhana, jatuh cinta pada Raga, CEO muda yang dingin. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh fitnah, perbedaan status, dan penolakan keluarga hingga Raga harus membuktikan kesungguhannya.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam - Cinta Dari Surga (Rr)
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah hidup dan percintaan gadis desa bernama Cinta yang menghadapi peliknya perbedaan status sosial serta intrik cinta segitiga. Semua berawal setelah Cinta mengalami insiden kecelakaan dan musibah yang membuatnya kehilangan barang-barang serta keluarganya di Jakarta. Di tengah keterpurukan, Revan pria dari kota dengan latar belakang kayadatang menolong dan selalu ada untuk Cinta. Hubungan Cinta dan Revan tidak berjalan mulus karena ibunda Revan menentang keras kedekatan mereka akibat perbedaan status sosial yang mencolok.

programme.title: Cinta Dari Surga

Tanpa disadari, ia terseret ke dalam dunia gelap kartel kriminal. Awalnya bekerja sama sebagai rekan, hubungan Gu Nian dan K perlahan berkembang menjadi cinta yang rumit di tengah situasi berbahaya. Saat ancaman semakin nyata, K rela mempertaruhkan nyawanya untuk melindungi Gu Nian dari bos kartel, Peng Li.

programme.title: Adieu Vinyle
programme.desc: Isabelle Adjani, Matthieu Dessertine, Mathieu Amalric, Jacques Bonnaffe, Barbara Pravi

programme.title: ADIEU VINYLE
programme.desc: Berlatar di Prancis tahun 1950-an, Adieu Vinyle mengisahkan Ève Faugère, seorang penyanyi terkenal yang menikmati kesuksesan besar tetapi menyimpan banyak masalah dalam kehidupan pribadinya. Ketika suaminya ditemukan tewas terbunuh, kecurigaan langsung mengarah kepadanya. Penyelidikan kemudian membuka berbagai rahasia, konflik, dan hubungan yang penuh ketegangan di balik kehidupan glamornya. Ève harus berjuang menghadapi tekanan publik dan penyelidikan polisi sambil berusaha membuktikan bahwa dirinya tidak bersalah. Dengan suasana retro yang kuat, film ini memadukan misteri kriminal, drama psikologis, dan kisah tentang ambisi, cinta, serta pengkhianatan.

programme.title: FOOT!
programme.desc: Foot! merupakan program olahraga Prancis yang berfokus pada sepak bola dengan menghadirkan berbagai informasi seputar pertandingan, pemain, klub, dan kompetisi penting. Acara ini menyajikan rangkuman pertandingan, analisis strategi, diskusi bersama pakar sepak bola, serta wawancara dengan tokoh-tokoh dunia sepak bola. Dengan pendekatan informatif dan mendalam, program ini menjadi sumber hiburan sekaligus wawasan bagi para penggemar sepak bola.

programme.title: LE CHOIX DU PIANISTE
programme.desc: Le Choix du Pianiste mengisahkan François Touraine, seorang pianis virtuoso Prancis yang hidupnya berubah drastis ketika Perang Dunia II pecah. Demi melindungi Rachel, perempuan Yahudi yang ia cintai, François terpaksa menerima kesempatan untuk bermain musik di Jerman pada masa kekuasaan Nazi. Keputusan tersebut membawanya ke dalam konflik batin yang mendalam antara cinta, moralitas, dan kelangsungan hidup. Setelah perang berakhir dan ia kembali ke Prancis, François harus menghadapi luka emosional serta konsekuensi dari pilihan-pilihan yang pernah ia buat. Pertemuannya dengan Annette memberinya kesempatan untuk bangkit kembali dan menemukan harapan baru. Dengan latar sejarah yang kuat, film ini menghadirkan kisah tentang cinta, pengorbanan, keberanian, dan kekuatan musik di tengah masa-masa paling kelam dalam sejarah Eropa.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: BooSnoo!
programme.desc: BooSnoo journeys into a world of springs and things that go boing. BooSnoo balloons don't go pop, but they do come in all shapes and size. Tick tock, tick tock. BooSnoo explores clockwork mechanisms, toys and of course clocks.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is a fun and educational show for kids featuring classic and new nursery rhymes. With her friends and family, 6-year-old Mia experiences the world around her through song and sometimes a bit of magic, too. A world where animals can dance, buses are friends and rainy days are never boring. Children love singing and dancing with Mia, Baby Max and a fun, diverse cast of animal, vehicle and human friends. Through the magic of rhythm and rhyme, their world comes alive.

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Meet the Sharksons - an adorable family of sharks who love to sing, explore, dance and play. The family lives in Splashy Reef, where they use diggers and excavators to keep the ocean clean. In this compilation, enjoy songs such as 'Wheels on the Bus', '5 Little Fishes' and many more kids songs and nursery rhymes!
programme.sub-title: Wheels on the Bus with the Sharksons by Little Baby Bum

programme.title: Rabbids Invasion
programme.desc: Based on a popular video game series, "Rabbids Invasion" features a mysterious breed of rabbitlike creatures that have come from another planet and that cause havoc everywhere they go in the human world.

programme.title: Classic Popeye
programme.desc: This episode includes Private Eye Popeye, Disguise the Limit, Spoil Sport and Popeye de Leon.
programme.sub-title: Private Eye Popeye / Disguise the Limit / Spoil Sport / Popeye de Leon

programme.title: Popeye: The Continuing Adventures

programme.title: Popeye: The Continuing Adventures

programme.title: Cutthroat Island
programme.desc: Feisty Morgan Adams (Geena Davis) inherits her late buccaneer father's galleon and one-third of a map to buried treasure located on Cutthroat Island. The map had been tattooed on her father's scalp, and to find the treasure, she must locate and scalp his two brothers. But Morgan's swashbuckling uncle, Dawg Brown (Frank Langella), wants the treasure for himself, and does battle with his headstrong niece and her unwilling accomplice, Latin-speaking physician William Shaw (Matthew Modine).

programme.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

programme.title: Bitch Slap
programme.desc: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

programme.title: Breaking and Entering
programme.desc: Will (Jude Law), a landscape architect in London, is in the middle of a life crisis. His relationship with Liv (Robin Wright Penn), a depressive Scandinavian, is going nowhere. A burglary at his office leads him to Amira (Juliette Binoche), a Bosnian refugee whose husband died in Sarajevo. Will is drawn to the vulnerable woman and initiates an affair.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

programme.title: Jackie's Back!
programme.desc: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: The Clapper
programme.desc: Eddie Krumble works as a paid audience member for infomercials and experiences a whirlwind of overnight fame after a late-night talk show host publicizes his frequent infomercial appearances.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: So Undercover
programme.desc: The FBI hires a young private detective to go undercover at a sorority to guard the daughter of an important witness in an organized-crime case.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Two high-school seniors make a pact to help each other lose their virginity before their prom, but their mission takes an unexpected turn when one announces that he's gay.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Generation Um...
programme.desc: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera.

programme.title: De-Lovely
programme.desc: At the staging of a musical production based on his life story, songwriter Cole Porter (Kevin Kline) begins to reflect on his life and career. As he trades notes with the play's director, Gabe (Jonathan Pryce), Porter recollects his meteoric rise on Broadway during the mid-1920s and his first meeting with wife and muse Linda Thomas (Ashley Judd). He also recalls his many extramarital, homosexual dalliances, and the deep depression and seclusion of his final years.

programme.title: 3 Generations
programme.desc: Three of the most acclaimed actors of their generations in a human comedy for today. In this family, change is relative.

programme.title: W.E.
programme.desc: Dissatisfied with the way her own life is playing out, New York-based Wally Winthrop (Abbie Cornish) becomes obsessed with the romance between American divorcee Wallis Simpson (Andrea Riseborough) and England's Edward VIII (James D'Arcy) when Sotheby's holds an auction of the royal couple's belongings. Wally is especially drawn to Wallis' side of the story, and as certain events transpire in her life, the line between fantasy and reality begins to blur.

As Piggott looks into whether the Yorkshire police tortured their suspect, Detective Jobson (David Morrissey) starts to regret his brutal past and reveals a secret that casts the entire case in a new light.

King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But Basquiat's tumultuous life, specifically his addiction to heroin, overshadows his rise to fame, threatening all.

Serving as Sam's soccer coach, Phil hopes to turn his last-place team of losers into champions, so they can beat the rival team coached by Buck.

However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Nick smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

programme.title: The Boss

After leaving jail, Darnell finds herself broke, homeless and hated. Luckily, she tracks down former assistant Claire (Kristen Bell), the only person who's willing to help. While staying with Claire and her young daughter, the ex-con devises a new business model for a brownie empire. Unfortunately, some old enemies stand in the way of her return to the top.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: When straight-laced Princeton University admissions officer Portia Nathan (Tina Fey) pays a recruiting visit to an alternative high school, she receives some news that catches her way off-guard. John Pressman (Paul Rudd), head of the school and Portia's former college classmate, has surmised that his student, Jeremiah, is the son that Portia secretly gave up for adoption. Portia puts her career at risk by bending the rules for Jeremiah but also discovers a life and romance she never imagined.

programme.title: Death Becomes Her

Years later, she returns home to confront the now-married couple, looking radiant. Her ex-husband's new wife wants to know her secret, and discovers that she has been taking a mysterious drug which grants eternal life to the person who drinks it. The actress follows suit, but discovers that immortality has a price.

Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Transporter 3
programme.desc: Mob courier Frank Martin's (Jason Statham) latest assignment pairs him with Valentina (Natalya Rudakova), the cynical daughter of a Ukrainian official. While her father ponders what to do with three boatloads of toxic waste, Frank must guard the problematic woman and prevent her from wandering too far from his vehicle, or risk triggering the explosive shackles they both wear.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Self-reformed petty criminal Terry Leather (Jason Statham) has become a financially struggling car dealer and settled into a pedestrian London life with his wife and kids, but takes the plunge into big crime when his ex-girlfriend, Martine (Saffron Burrows), turns up with an offer to pull off a lucrative bank heist. After Terry assembles his crew of misfits and begins the operation, he finds that there are other agendas at play, and powerful players who have designs on the vault's contents.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: The Expendables 4

programme.sub-title: Light and Shadow! Darkness behind Dressrosa!

programme.sub-title: Making a Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland!

programme.sub-title: The Fierce Battle Coming to the End! Lucy vs. Chin Jao!

programme.sub-title: Protect You to the End! Rebecca and the Toy Soldier!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: The Last - and Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!

programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. the Straw Hats!

programme.sub-title: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish of the White Horse!

programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. programme.sub-title: All You Need is a Goal

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.desc: A squad of elite human soldiers faces down a powerful and deadly extraterrestrial army. Starring Kevin Sorbo (2014)

programme.desc: The tempestuous romance that inspired one of Gothic literature's most influential works is brought to life in Mary Shelley, a luscious and moving period drama starring Elle Fanning and directed by Haifaa al-Mansour (Wadjda).

programme.desc: Johnny Depp unlocks the gates of hell in the tense thriller directed by Roman Polanski. After a rare-book dealer (Depp) is hired to locate the last copies of a demonic manuscript, he's swept into a web of theft, murder, and terrifying satanic rituals.

programme.title: Suburbicon
programme.desc: Directed by George Clooney, SUBURBICON is a cold-blooded thriller set in the peaceful streets of suburbia. Here, the picket-fenced homes and manicured lawns look like the perfect place to raise a family...

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: At a turning point in his life, a former tennis pro falls for an actress who happens to be dating his friend and soon-to-be brother-in-law.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: A conservative judge is appointed by the President to spearhead America's escalating war against drugs, only to discover that his teenage daughter is an addict.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: The Monster
programme.desc: A mother and daughter must confront a terrifying monster when they break down on a deserted road.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice

programme.title: Repression
programme.desc: A gripping and twisty Hitchcock-esque thriller set in Scotland with a stellar British cast, including Peter Mullan and Rebecca Front. When therapist Marianne attempts a new life, she is thrown off course by her young patient Manny who claims he can control her future. Marianne struggles with silence from her colleagues and her own mind as she tries to uncover the truth behind Mannys drawings.

programme.title: Operation Wolfhound
programme.desc: One of the most shocking moments in World War II history is brought to life. In 1944 German-occupied France, the Nazis developed a Trojan horse plot that aimed to incapacitate the allied forces in the skies and was the beginnings of an enemy action to level a major European city! The only resilience against this Nazi threat are those allied officers caught and captured in its web.

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: Drugs. Money. Greed. Death. When a drug bust goes horribly wrong, David (Bruce Willis - Die Hard) , a decorated cop, finds himself at the mercy of a drug cartel. As the violent gang seeks refuge on farmland they soon discover one man (Chad Michael Murray - Riverdale) with a deadly aim who stands between them and freedom. Welcome to the Killing Field.

programme.title: Redwood
programme.desc: Breakout film at Frightfest Festival and a must-watch for all horror fans! Josh and Beth visit a secluded national park for some quality time. Ignoring the advice of the Park Rangers, they venture off trail and come face to face with Redwood's legendary wildlife. A fresh spin to a well-worn mythology, creating an edge-of-your seat movie to shred your nerves and make you think twice about camping.

programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. The Furies is Halloween meets The Hunger Games in this gripping & fast paced female-driven survival thriller. A young woman faces her darkest fears with seven other unwilling participants in a deadly game. A game that can only have one winner.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face

programme.desc: When a successful bachelor suddenly finds himself as the guardian of a 10 year old boy, he leans on the smart and beautiful social worker for help, only to fall in love with the woman who turned his life upside down.

But after the death of her military father, she and her mother are in danger of losing their family ranch too. With a little help from friends and their majestic white horse, they hatch a plan to raise enough money to save the ranch while learning to never lose hope, despite all odds.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: Attempting to connect with the woman he has begun to love, Adam offers to bring Persephone's brother to Falstone, as well as host a ball. He wants Falstone Castle to feel like home to Persephone. The tender affection growing between them gives Persephone hope, but she cannot seem to get past the walls he has built around his heart.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.

programme.title: Bedazzled

programme.title: Snow Way
programme.desc: Practicing for the local snow lodge's big snowboard race, Mia has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no biggie, but when she tries to resume practice, the normally fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! At the local snow lodge's Snowboard Meet, ace snowboarder Mia, trying to raise money for a new Heartlake City animal shelter, enters the fiercest race of all – the Boardercross. Then, while practicing, she has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no big deal, but once she heals and tries to resume practice, the usually fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! With the help of her Friends, she tries hard to overcome her fear, but her nightmarish visions of snowboard monsters and jeering snowmen have her shaking in her bed. She backs out of the race, disappointing her Friends and herself. Finally, when an avalanche traps Fiona, Mia is forced to overcome her fears and race to the rescue.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: No Blueberry Is an Island

Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does, so they can prepare accordingly—they see Strawberry wearing a diving mask and snorkel in the cafe, and race to the lake to practice scuba diving, not knowing she was only slicing onions.

programme.title: Where the Berry Breeze Blows
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here! She insists they can build a copy of “Berry Breezy Bay” resort on Berry Bitty Lake, a duplicate down to the last detail.

programme.title: The Berry Best Vacation
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top “Entertainment Tonight”-style show host/producer from Episode 206. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation. Trying to accommodate Mavis and continue their vacation doesn't work—every time the girls try to have fun together, Mavis pops up, poking a microphone in Cherry's face, insisting on treating her as if she were a Lady Gaga-type.

programme.title: The Berry Long Winter
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City—a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play “Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose.” The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing. But it turns out the Berrykins' version of the game has different rules: they zoom around on little hang gliders made of leaves!
